name: Bhargav Saikia
bio: Bhargav Saikia is a Mumbai-based film director, producer and the founder of Lorien Motion Pictures. Saikia's feature directorial debut, Bokshi (2025), premiered at the 54th International Film Festival Rotterdam (IFFR). The film was subsequently screened at the 58th Sitges International Fantastic Film Festival of Catalonia and the 24th Neuchâtel International Fantastic Film Festival (NIFFF).

credits.title: Bokshi
credits.overview: Anahita, traumatised by the brutal disappearance of her mother, finds comfort in Shalini, her history teacher. On an unconventional school excursion to a mysterious prehistoric site, she confronts her terrifying destiny.

credits.title: The Black Cat
credits.overview: A black cat and a mysterious woman by the name of Miss Bellows show up at Mr. Bond's quaint cottage after he brings home an old broomstick from an antique shop.

credits.title: Awakenings
credits.overview: Chased by a malevolent entity, a babysitter's child care session turns into a nightmare as reality becomes more and more twisted.

credits.title: Kaafiron Ki Namaaz
credits.overview: 'Kaafiron Ki Namaaz' is about a recently court martialed army officer, a writer and a musician who confess their most personal secrets to each other on a rainy Christmas Eve somewhere in Srinagar, Kashmir.
